binding_anchor.explanation: Bound to the fixed parent commit + tree and the preserved source working-tree NUL-status digest. Candidate commit/tree hashes are deliberately omitted here: including them would make this receipt self-referential (the receipt is itself part of the candidate commit it would name), which Sol audit reason 3 rejected. They are recorded externally by Orca/the final checkpoint via git rev-parse HEAD after the amend — never fabricated inside this receipt.

manifest_sha256_method: Non-circular manifest digest: SHA-256 of the accepted-path manifest serialized as canonical JSON (sort_keys=True, separators=(',' ,':'), ensure_ascii=False) with the manifest_sha256 key omitted. Omitting manifest_sha256 avoids self-reference: the digest is a pure function of the manifest content fields only. It is intentionally not a raw whole-file SHA-256, because a file cannot truthfully record its own full-file hash without a fixed point. This exact digest is recorded identically in the manifest itself.
